title: AtCoder Express 4
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2.5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq N\leq 10^5; 1\leq M\leq 10^5; 0\leq x_1 < x_2 < \ldots < x_N \leq 10^{12}; 1\leq l_i\leq r_i\leq N, 1\leq L_i\leq R_i\leq N; r_i\lt L_i or R_i\lt l_i.; 1\leq c_i\leq 10^{12}; All input values are integers.
